notes: Asking Crisp to slow down only part of a clip now slows only that part. If you picked a section and set a speed, Crisp ignored the section and retimed the whole clip — a longer render than you asked for, and the wrong piece. Trimming works the same way now whether you are slowing a clip down or speeding it up. One thing this build does not change: slow motion still works by playing the frames you have more slowly rather than creating new in-between ones, so a heavily slowed clip can still look stepped. Nothing got slower.
